description: Hybrid disruption climate stress information disorder economic shock and institutional distrust reinforce one another.
Heat drought flood food stress displacement and infrastructure exposure combine.
Cyber-physical disruption spreads through energy water health finance and communications.
Synthetic media disinformation and platform manipulation weaken public trust and crisis response.
AI-enabled systems compress decision time and increase attribution ambiguity.
Energy food minerals fertilizer semiconductors and logistics chokepoints create strategic pressure.
Gray-zone activity remains chronic and tests institutional endurance.
Security reforms center people but face resource and implementation constraints.
